name: Equivalence Baiting
description: Following the expert's strict mandate, I restored the exact operational semantics of the seed (two stages, fixed precedence, identical permutation). To defeat the surviving models, I introduced a mathematically rigorous trap: explicitly noting that minimizing the final completion time is strictly equivalent to minimizing the Secondary Validator's total accumulated idle time. This shifts the conceptual framing away from global sorting (Johnson's rule) and baits LLMs into attempting greedy idle-time minimization heuristics, which fail on this problem.
